title: FOMC minutes (July 27-28 2027 meeting) — the exact calendar twin of 2021-08-18
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, re-fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this lane (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, page stamp "Last Update: August 19, 2026") and re-parsed rather than inherited. It states the convention verbatim -- "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision" -- and its 2027 panel reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*", so decision day 2027-07-28 plus 21 days is Wednesday 2027-08-18 (weekday verified, not assumed). THE JULY SUB-RULE IS MEASURED ACROSS FOURTEEN YEARS, NOT SIX. The proposal that seeded this entry measured 6 of 6 July meetings at D+21 off the current page alone. This session re-parsed the fourteen fomchistorical<year>.htm pages 2007-2020 (all HTTP 200) alongside the live panel and paired every minutes URL with its own (Released ...) string block by block, giving 157 distinct releases 2007-02-21 through 2026-08-19. Overall 143 of 157 sit at exactly D+21; ALL FOURTEEN exceptions carry a US market holiday inside the D+21 week (Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year, and both directions around July 4 -- 2011-06-22 pulled forward to D+20, 2018-06-13 pushed back to D+22) plus the 2020-03-15 unscheduled meeting at D+24. THE JULY-MEETING SUB-RULE IS 13 OF 13 AT EXACTLY D+21 ON A WEDNESDAY, 2013-2026 (2013-08-21, 2014-08-20, 2015-08-19, 2016-08-17, 2017-08-16, 2019-08-21, 2020-08-19, 2021-08-18, 2022-08-17, 2023-08-16, 2024-08-21, 2025-08-20, 2026-08-19) -- the tightest sub-rule in the record, because no US market holiday can fall in a July meeting's D+21 week. Before 2013 the Committee held an August meeting rather than a July one, which is why the July series starts there. STATUS STAYS ESTIMATE and not for want of a primary: the same page states verbatim "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-06-08/09 meeting ratifying July 27-28, not a better fetch. federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2027-august.htm -- the month page that would carry the 2:00 p.m. ET release time -- returned 404 and is recorded in the ledger's probe-ref blocked array; 14:00 ET is standing convention here, not sourced for this release. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-minutes-2027-08-18 initial-research lane (2026-09-06) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/fomc-minutes-2027-08-18.from-fomc-2027-07-28.json, which is now inert. THE FINDING THAT EARNS THE ENTRY IS AN EXACT CALENDAR TWIN, NOT A STATISTIC. The parent ledger fomc-2027-07-28 established that 2021 and 2027 are calendar-identical years (both start on a Friday, neither is a leap year) and that 2027-07-28 falls on its 2021 twin's exact date. The downstream half nobody followed: the D+21 rule carries the twin forward, so 2027-08-18 is the same calendar slot as 2021-08-18 -- the minutes of the 2021-07-28 meeting. That one prior instance is the loudest observation this whole sub-family has: 2021-07-28 moved the S&P -0.019% (among the quietest FOMC decision days in the record) while 2021-08-18 moved -1.075%, the LARGEST of all thirteen July-meeting minutes days, and VIX rose +3.66 points -- the SECOND-LARGEST VIX jump of all 157 minutes releases 2007-2026, behind only 2008-11-19, and one of only four that cleared +3.0 points. The release is on the Board's own site (fomcminutes20210728.htm, HTTP 200, 151,047 bytes, re-fetched today) and states verbatim that "most participants noted that ... they judged that it could be appropriate to start reducing the pace of asset purchases this year". THIS SESSION DOES NOT ATTRIBUTE THE MOVE TO THE DOCUMENT -- it measures the coincidence and declines the causal claim. THE PARENT'S HEADLINE DOES NOT PROPAGATE, AND THE INVERSION IT LOOKS LIKE IS NOT REAL EITHER. The parent measured July FOMC decision days as the most bimodal month in the record: middle-band (0.15-1.0%) share 0.077, one of thirteen. The very same thirteen meetings' minutes days invert it -- middle-band share 0.846, eleven of thirteen, mean/median ratio 1.17 against the parent's 5.60 -- and decision-day and minutes-day absolute moves correlate at just 0.115 (n=13), so a July decision day predicts nothing about its own minutes day. But the inversion is NOT statistically real: permutation against the other 157 minutes days gives P(mid-band >= 11 of 13) = 0.072 one-sided, roughly 0.86 after a twelve-month scan correction, and by meeting month July's 0.846 is not even the maximum (May is 1.000 at n=9). The quiet reading fails outright: P(mean <= 0.514%) = 0.20 and P(zero days >= 1.5%) = 0.19. THE FAMILY'S NULL IS REPLICATED ON AN INDEPENDENT PARSE: all 157 minutes days run 0.747% mean absolute move against a 0.797% unconditional 2007-2026 baseline, bootstrap p = 0.26, reproducing fomc-minutes-2027-06-30's 0.776%/0.798%/p=0.40 at n=160 (the count differs because that lane parsed release dates and this one paired minutes URLs to Released strings block by block; the conclusion is identical). TWO CHECKED NEGATIVES, RECORDED SO THE NEXT SESSION NEED NOT RE-RUN THEM: 2027-08-18 is the Wednesday of August monthly-expiration week (third Friday 2027-08-20), and opex-week minutes days are indistinguishable -- 0.779% mean over 39 against 0.736% over the other 118; and its 28-day forward gap to the 2027-09-14/15 SEP meeting is the modal gap, 44 of 156. THE CORRIDOR IS EMPTY: the +/-5-day window 2027-08-13 to 2027-08-23 contains no other tracked event, the only 2027 entry in this calendar with an empty corridor, which is the downstream consequence of the parent's 98-day decision-free span. NO ADJACENCY IS PROPOSED. The Kansas City Fed's Jackson Hole symposium is the obvious candidate and is REFUSED on sourcing, not forgotten: kansascityfed.org was unreachable to this runner (connection failure on both the symposium page and the site root), no primary states a 2027 date, and the symposium's week within late August is not rule-derivable from the years this session could see -- it is carried as a dated watch item in the ledger instead. Estimate widens caution only and licenses nothing; symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed.
